```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, tidy = TRUE)

set.seed(42)
```

# Load Packages

```{r packages, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(ranger)
library(tidymodels)
library(DALEXtra) #Explainer (variable importance, partial dependence, etc)
library(spatialsample) #Use for spatial cross validation
library(car) #VIF function
library(pdp) #for use in heatmaps
library(patchwork) #Combine final figures

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(yardstick::rmse)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
```

# Load Data

```{r data, results = FALSE}
plots <- st_read(here("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg"), layer = "allplotsDS") 

plots$Northness[is.na(plots$Northness)] <- 0

plots_100m <- filter(plots, Radius == 100)
plots_250m <- filter(plots, Radius == 250)
plots_500m <- filter(plots, Radius == 500)
```

# Correlation of Predictor Variables

VIF and linear correlation

```{r correlation}
model1 <- lm(Prop_High_Sev ~ Prop_Treated + Trt_Age + Northness + Elevation + Slope + Daily_Area + Extreme + TCC + Prop_Conifer + Prop_Conifer_Hardwood + Prop_Hardwood, data = plots)

vif(model1)

# Removing Extreme in favor of Daily_Area and removing Conifer_Hardwood in favor of Conifer
model2 <- lm(Prop_High_Sev ~ Prop_Treated + Trt_Age + Northness + Elevation + Slope + Daily_Area + TCC + Prop_Conifer + Prop_Hardwood, data = plots)

vif(model2)

preds <- c("Prop_Treated", "Trt_Age", "Northness", "Elevation", "Slope", "Daily_Area", "TCC", "Prop_Conifer", "Prop_Hardwood") #For use later in VIPs
```

# Proportion of High-Severity

## 100m

```{r hi100-split}
data_split_hi100 <- initial_split(plots_100m, strata = "Prop_High_Sev", prop = 0.80)
hi100_train <- training(data_split_hi100)
hi100_test  <- testing(data_split_hi100)
```

Create a recipe
```{r hi100-rec}
hi100_rec <- recipe(Prop_High_Sev ~ Prop_Treated + Trt_Age + Northness + Elevation + Slope + Daily_Area + TCC + Prop_Conifer + Prop_Hardwood, data = hi100_train)

hi100_prep <- prep(hi100_rec)
```

Set up a model specification to tune
```{r hi100-spec}
tune_spec <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), 
                         trees = 2000,
                         min_n = tune()) %>%
              set_mode("regression") %>%
              set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation")
```

Set up a workflow
```{r hi100-flow}
tune_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(hi100_rec) %>%
  add_model(tune_spec)
```

Tune hyperparameters based on RMSE
```{r hi100-tune}
hi100_folds <- spatial_clustering_cv(hi100_train)

doParallel::registerDoParallel()

rf_grid <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(1, 9)),
  min_n(range = c(1,40)),
  levels = 5
)

regular_res <- tune_grid(
  tune_wf,
  resamples = hi100_folds,
  grid = rf_grid
)

regular_res %>%
  collect_metrics() %>%
  filter(.metric == "rmse") %>%
  mutate(min_n = factor(min_n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(mtry, mean, color = min_n)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point()
```

Select Best Fit
```{r hi100-best}
best_rmse <- select_best(regular_res, metric = "rmse")
final_workflow_hi100 <- tune_wf %>%
  finalize_workflow(best_rmse)
```

Evaluate metrics across spatial crossvalidation folds
```{r hi100-metrics}
rf_res <- 
    final_workflow_hi100 %>% 
    fit_resamples(
      resamples = hi100_folds, 
      metrics = metric_set(rmse, rsq),
      control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
      ) 
  
rf_res %>%  
  collect_metrics(summarize = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Dataset="training") %>% 
  mutate(Model="RF") 

rf_res %>% 
  collect_metrics(summarize = FALSE) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(.metric == "rmse") 

rf_res %>% 
  collect_metrics(summarize = FALSE) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(.metric == "rsq") 
```

Fit Final Model
```{r hi100-final}
final_fit_hi100 <- final_workflow_hi100 %>%
  last_fit(data_split_hi100)

collect_metrics(final_fit_hi100)      # test-set RMSE, R², etc.
hi100_predictions <- collect_predictions(final_fit_hi100)  # observed vs. predicted on the held-out test set
ggplot(hi100_predictions, aes(Prop_High_Sev, .pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25)+
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Observed",
    y = "Predicted",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Observed vs. Predicted Proportion of High Severity Fire, 100 m"
  )

final_fitted_hi100 <- final_fit_hi100$.workflow[[1]]
final_fitted_hi100
```

Explainer
```{r hi100-explainer}
hi100_explainer <- explain_tidymodels(
  final_fitted_hi100,
  data = hi100_train %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% dplyr::select(all_of(preds), Incid_Name),
  y = hi100_train$Prop_High_Sev,
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

Variable Importance Plot 
```{r hi100-vip}
# Variable Importance Plots
vip_hi100 <- variable_importance(hi100_explainer,
                                variables = preds)
plot(vip_hi100) 
```

PDP
```{r hi100-pdp}
pdp_hi100 <- model_profile(
  hi100_explainer,
  variables = preds,
  N = NULL
)
plot(pdp_hi100)
```

# Proportion of Moderate to High-severity

## 100m

Create a recipe
```{r mohi100-rec}
mohi100_rec <- recipe(Prop_Mod_High_Sev ~ Prop_Treated + Trt_Age + Northness + Elevation + Slope + Daily_Area + TCC + Prop_Conifer + Prop_Hardwood, data = mohi100_train)

```

Set up a model specification to tune

```{r mohi100-flow}
  add_model(tune_spec)
```

Tune hyperparameters based on RMSE
```{r mohi100-tune}

mohi100_folds %>%
  mutate(held_out_fire = map(splits, ~ assessment(.x) %>% distinct(Incid_Name))) %>%
  unnest(held_out_fire) %>%
  select(id, Incid_Name)

doParallel::registerDoParallel()
#show_notes(.Last.tune.result)

rf_grid <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(1, 9)),
  min_n(range = c(1,40)),
  levels = 5
)

  resamples = mohi100_folds,

  mutate(min_n = factor(min_n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(mtry, mean, color = min_n)) +

  geom_point()
```


```{r mohi100-metrics}
    fit_resamples(
      resamples = mohi100_folds, 
      metrics = metric_set(rmse, rsq),
      control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
      ) 
  
rf_res %>%  
  collect_metrics(summarize = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Dataset="training") %>% 
  mutate(Model="RF") 

rf_res %>% 
  collect_metrics(summarize = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(.metric == "rmse") 

rf_res %>% 
  collect_metrics(summarize = FALSE) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(.metric == "rsq") 
```

Fit Final Model
```{r mohi100-final}
final_fit_mohi100 <- final_workflow_mohi100 %>%
  last_fit(data_split_mohi100)

collect_metrics(final_fit_mohi100)      # test-set RMSE, R², etc.
mohi100_predictions <- collect_predictions(final_fit_mohi100)  # observed vs. predicted on the held-out test set

  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  labs(
```

```{r mohi500-tune}
  resamples = mohi500_folds,
  grid = rf_grid
)

regular_res %>%
  collect_metrics() %>%
  filter(.metric == "rmse") %>%
  mutate(min_n = factor(min_n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(mtry, mean, color = min_n)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point()
```

Select Best Fit
```{r mohi500-best}
best_rmse <- select_best(regular_res, metric = "rmse")
final_workflow_mohi500 <- tune_wf %>%
  finalize_workflow(best_rmse)
```

Evaluate metrics across spatial crossvalidation folds
```{r mohi500-metrics}
rf_res <- 
    final_workflow_mohi500 %>% 
    fit_resamples(
      resamples = mohi500_folds, 
      metrics = metric_set(rmse, rsq),
      control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
      ) 
  
rf_res %>%  
  collect_metrics(summarize = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Dataset="training") %>% 
  mutate(Model="RF") 

rf_res %>% 
  collect_metrics(summarize = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(.metric == "rmse") 

rf_res %>% 
  collect_metrics(summarize = FALSE) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(.metric == "rsq") 
```

Fit Final Model
```{r mohi500-final}
final_fit_mohi500 <- final_workflow_mohi500 %>%
  last_fit(data_split_mohi500)

collect_metrics(final_fit_mohi500)      # test-set RMSE, R², etc.
mohi500_predictions <- collect_predictions(final_fit_mohi500)  # observed vs. predicted on the held-out test set
ggplot(mohi500_predictions, aes(Prop_Mod_High_Sev, .pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25)+
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Observed",
    y = "Predicted",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Observed vs. Predicted Proportion of Moderate to High Severity Fire, 500 m"
  )

final_fitted_mohi500 <- final_fit_mohi500$.workflow[[1]]
final_fitted_mohi500
```

Explainer
```{r mohi500-explainer}
mohi500_explainer <- explain_tidymodels(
  final_fitted_mohi500,
  data = mohi500_train %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% dplyr::select(all_of(preds), Incid_Name),
  y = mohi500_train$Prop_Mod_High_Sev,
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

Variable Importance Plot 
```{r mohi500-vip}
# Variable Importance Plots
vip_mohi500 <- variable_importance(mohi500_explainer,
                                variables = preds)
plot(vip_mohi500) 
```

PDP
```{r mohi500-pdp}
pdp_mohi500 <- model_profile(
  mohi500_explainer,
  variables = preds,
  N = NULL
)
plot(pdp_mohi500)
```


# Figures

## Combined Multi-Scale VIP and PDPs

Variable Importance

```{r comb-vip}
# --- PANEL A: High-Severity Fire VIP ---
vip_hi_list <- list(
  "100m"  = vip_hi100,
  "250m" = vip_hi250,
  "500m" = vip_hi500
)

df_vip_hi <- map_dfr(vip_hi_list, as.data.frame, .id = "Scale") %>%
  mutate(mse = dropout_loss^2) %>%                # RMSE -> MSE, before averaging
  group_by(Scale) %>%
  mutate(full_mse = mean(mse[variable == "_full_model_"], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!variable %in% c("_full_model_", "_baseline_")) %>%
  group_by(Scale, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mse      = mean(mse, na.rm = TRUE),
    full_mse = first(full_mse),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Scale = factor(Scale, levels = c("100m", "250m", "500m")),
    mse_increase_pct = (mse - full_mse) / full_mse * 100
  )

# --- PANEL C: Moderate/High-Severity Fire VIP ---
vip_mohi_list <- list(
  "100m"  = vip_mohi100,
  "250m" = vip_mohi250,
  "500m" = vip_mohi500
)

df_vip_mohi <- map_dfr(vip_mohi_list, as.data.frame, .id = "Scale") %>%
  mutate(mse = dropout_loss^2) %>%                # RMSE -> MSE, before averaging
  group_by(Scale) %>%
  mutate(full_mse = mean(mse[variable == "_full_model_"], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!variable %in% c("_full_model_", "_baseline_")) %>%
  group_by(Scale, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mse      = mean(mse, na.rm = TRUE),
    full_mse = first(full_mse),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Scale = factor(Scale, levels = c("100m", "250m", "500m")),
    mse_increase_pct = (mse - full_mse) / full_mse * 100
  )
```

Partial Dependence Plot

```{r comb-pdp}
# --- PANEL B: High-Severity PDP ---
pdp_hi_list <- list(
  "100m"  = pdp_hi100,
  "250m" = pdp_hi250,
  "500m" = pdp_hi500
)

df_pdp_hi <- map_dfr(pdp_hi_list, ~ .x$agr_profiles, .id = "Scale") %>%
  filter(`_vname_` == "Prop_Treated") %>% # filter to treated area predictor
  mutate(Scale = factor(Scale, levels = c("100m", "250m", "500m")))

# --- PANEL D: Moderate/High-Severity PDP ---
pdp_mohi_list <- list(
  "100m"  = pdp_mohi100,
  "250m" = pdp_mohi250,
  "500m" = pdp_mohi500
)

df_pdp_mohi <- map_dfr(pdp_mohi_list, ~ .x$agr_profiles, .id = "Scale") %>%
  filter(`_vname_` == "Prop_Treated") %>%
  mutate(Scale = factor(Scale, levels = c("100m", "250m", "500m")))
```

Build ggplots

```{r comb-plot}
# Custom color palette
scale_colors <- c(
  "100m"  = "#0d0887",
  "250m" = "#cc4678",
  "500m" = "#f0f921"
)

# --- Plot A: VIP High Severity ---
p_a <- ggplot(df_vip_hi, aes(x = mse_increase_pct, y = reorder(variable, mse_increase_pct), color = Scale)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# --- Plot B: PDP High Severity ---
p_b <- ggplot(df_pdp_hi, aes(x = `_x_`, y = `_yhat_`, color = Scale)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "p(high-severity fire)") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# --- Plot C: VIP Moderate/High Severity ---
p_c <- ggplot(df_vip_mohi, aes(x = mse_increase_pct, y = reorder(variable, mse_increase_pct), color = Scale)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  labs(x = "Increase in MSE (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# --- Plot D: PDP Moderate/High Severity ---
p_d <- ggplot(df_pdp_mohi, aes(x = `_x_`, y = `_yhat_`, color = Scale)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scale_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of Area Treated", y = "p(moderate/high-severity fire)") +
  guides(color = "none") + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig1 <- (p_a + p_b) / (p_c + p_d) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Display final figure
print(fig1)
```

## Interaction PDPs

```{r int-prep}
hi100_train <- hi100_train %>% st_drop_geometry
hi250_train <- hi250_train %>% st_drop_geometry
hi500_train <- hi500_train %>% st_drop_geometry
mohi100_train <- mohi100_train %>% st_drop_geometry
mohi250_train <- mohi250_train %>% st_drop_geometry
mohi500_train <- mohi500_train %>% st_drop_geometry

pred_fun <- function(object, newdata) {
  mean(predict(object, new_data = newdata)$.pred)
}
```

### Daily Area Burned x Extent Treated

Create dataframes

```{r int-dab-data}
pd_dab_hi100 <- pdp::partial(
  final_fitted_hi100,
  pred.var = c("Prop_Treated", "Daily_Area"),
  train    = hi100_train,    
  pred.fun = pred_fun,
  chull = TRUE
)

pd_dab_hi250 <- pdp::partial(
  final_fitted_hi250,
  pred.var = c("Prop_Treated", "Daily_Area"),
  train    = hi250_train,    
  pred.fun = pred_fun,
  chull = TRUE
)

pd_dab_hi500 <- pdp::partial(
  final_fitted_hi500,
  pred.var = c("Prop_Treated", "Daily_Area"),
  train    = hi500_train,    
  pred.fun = pred_fun,
  chull = TRUE
)
```

Build ggplots
```{r int-dab}
lims_hi   <- range(c(pd_dab_hi100$yhat,   pd_dab_hi250$yhat,   pd_dab_hi500$yhat))

p1 <- ggplot(pd_dab_hi100, aes(Prop_Treated, Daily_Area, fill = yhat)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = lims_hi, na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(title = "100m", x = NULL, y = "Daily Area Burned",
       fill = "Predicted Proportion\nHigh-Severity") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p2 <- ggplot(pd_dab_hi250, aes(Prop_Treated, Daily_Area, fill = yhat)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = lims_hi, na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(title = "250m", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p3 <- ggplot(pd_dab_hi500, aes(Prop_Treated, Daily_Area, fill = yhat)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = lims_hi, na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(title = "500m", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

row_hi   <- (p1 + p2 + p3) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")

#Just High Severity
fig3 <- row_hi &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
fig3
```
